finalText:
Found it and fixed it. `packages/shared/config.js` used `Object.assign` to layer defaults, package overrides, and CLI flags — a shallow merge, so any override touching `output` or `sourcemap` wiped out the sibling keys instead of just changing the one named. `@acme/api`, `@acme/web`, and `@acme/cli` all did this, which is why bundling failed with `config-incomplete`.

I changed the merge to combine nested objects key-by-key instead of replacing them wholesale. Build now finishes clean: **0 errors, 5 warnings**, `verify.js` also passes.
